title: Owner: open the full dashboard with nerv open full
goal: The owner confirms the full dashboard opens signed in
acceptance: On NERV-01 after the lifecycle update, in Terminal: `nerv open full`. Expected: the browser opens http://127.0.0.1:4317/full (the #code part disappears at once) on the full dashboard, signed in, with no sign-in box. Then `nerv open --print`. Expected: one line http://127.0.0.1:4317/#code=… (32 hex characters), as before
privacy: The owner keeps the printed code to themselves; nothing from it goes into Git.
validation: Owner check, recorded in B-184 Verification
escalation: The owner decides; the agent records the result

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: two commands on the Mac. Not a measurement.
